Name: Stardew Cigars
Author: WhittyJr
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This adds a custom tobacco crop. Tobacco is planted during the Fall. The leaves are cured at a craftable curing rack, which produces a cigar as an artisan good you can sell. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip the mod files and place the extracted folder into your mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher, SMAPI[/color][/size]

If this gets any attention, I might try to make a new version that includes a smoking animation.
